_note: Every money assumption used by scripts/economics.py. 'sourced' values come from the linked public document; 'assumption' values are stated estimates you can change here. All dollars are SGD.

new_line_cost_per_km.detail: Cross Island Line: projected S$40.7 billion for a line of about 50 km, i.e. ~S$0.8 billion per km including stations, tunnels, systems and depot

infill_station_cost.detail: Brickland (NS3A) elevated infill station and viaduct, Contract 115 awarded Dec 2025 at ~S$281 million. An underground infill without a pre-built box would cost more.

train_cost_6car.detail: 40 R151 six-car trains for S$337.8 million (Sep 2020) = ~S$8.4 million per train

bus_cost_per_year.detail: Back-of-envelope from an early Bus Contracting Model tender: ~S$252,727 per bus per year

median_monthly_income.detail: MOM: median gross monthly income of full-time employed residents, 2025, incl. employer CPF

value_of_time_share.detail: Commuting time valued at 50% of the hourly wage, a common transport-appraisal convention

weekend_factor.detail: A weekend/holiday day has ~60% of weekday ridership (close to what the LTA tap data shows)

rail_share_new_residents.detail: Share of newly served residents who make a return rail trip on a weekday

minutes_saved_new_station.detail: Minutes saved per trip when a long walk or feeder bus to the MRT is replaced by a station within ~10-min walk

price_uplift_near_station.detail: HDB resale within ~400 m of an MRT sells ~3-6% above the town median (prices.html); 3% used, applied once to homes near new stations

train_cost_per_train_hour.detail: Running cost of one train for one hour (staff, energy, wear). No public figure found; change this to test

peak_15min_factor.detail: The busiest 15 minutes are ~30% fuller than the hour's average

target_load.detail: Aim to keep the busiest 15 minutes below 85% of crush capacity

max_trains_per_hour.detail: Upper limit with modern signalling (~100 s between trains)

taxi_late_fare.detail: Typical late-night taxi fare home from town incl. the 50% midnight surcharge

bus_feeder_minutes.detail: Typical wait + ride for a feeder bus leg to the MRT
